stem: Which idea in the selection “Riding Out West” is SIMILAR in the poem “Going Home (Burlington Route)”?

options.label: A
options.text: People value the freedom to move easily from one place to another.

options.label: B
options.text: People prefer to travel to places that are the farthest away from their homes.

options.label: C
options.text: People believe traveling to new places will help them find better opportunities.

options.label: D
options.text: People should work together to find new ways to appreciate the world around them.
